_about: The network explorer data. Every link is documented in the sources. Places show where APARN has met, worked or is based through its convenors; they are NOT member locations. Add approved member-location data under memberLocations when it exists.

places.label: Porto
places.text: APARN gathered at SAR’s 16th International Conference on Artistic Research in 2025, where Rebordering the Archipelago was launched.

places.label: Galway
places.text: Members were invited to gather online during SAR’s 2026 forum at the University of Galway, 23–26 June 2026.

places.label: Oslo
places.text: Convenors Danny Butt and Kurniawan Adi Saputro, with original APARN member Helly Minarti, developed the Climate/Coloniality residency with PRAKSIS Oslo (August–September 2025).

places.label: Bratislava
places.text: SAR 2027, “Beyond the Familiar”, takes place here on 21–23 April 2027. An APARN gathering is proposed; details to be confirmed.

places.label: Ann Arbor
places.text: Home of the Penny W. Stamps School of Art and Design, University of Michigan, where convenor Gunalan Nadarajan is a professor.

places.label: Bangkok
places.text: Chulalongkorn University hosted APARN2025, the largest meeting so far, with over 150 presentations from 22 countries.

places.label: Cyberjaya
places.text: MMU’s Faculty of Creative Multimedia hosted APARN2024. It is also home to APARN’s Director, Dr Roopesh Sitharan.

places.label: Singapore
places.text: NAFA, University of the Arts Singapore, hosted ADPRex × APARN 2026. The exhibition Chapalang opened at Artspace @ Helutrans in January 2026, and LASALLE College of the Arts joined the 2020 postgraduate symposium.

places.label: Vietnam
places.text: RMIT University Vietnam will host APARN2027, APARN’s first conference in Vietnam. City, dates and theme are to be confirmed.

places.label: Yogyakarta
places.text: Where APARN began. ISI Yogyakarta co-founded the network, and the city hosted the first meeting (2019) and APARN2023.

places.label: Melbourne
places.text: Home of the University of Melbourne’s Centre of Visual Art, APARN’s other co-founder, which presented the online APARN2020.

places.label: Online
places.text: Three annual meetings were held online, in 2020, 2021 and 2022, timed for Melbourne and Yogyakarta.

practices.label: Archipelagos and decolonial exchange
practices.text: Thinking with oceans, islands and regional solidarity against colonial borders.

practices.label: Emerging researchers
practices.text: Graduate and independent researchers finding each other across the region.

practices.label: Planet, ecology and climate
practices.text: Local ecologies, extraction, climate and our responsibilities to the planet.

practices.label: Materials and making
practices.text: The matter of art: what artists work with, and why it matters.

practices.label: Art, technology and reasoning
practices.text: Art as a way of reasoning, and the cultures of technology across Southeast Asia.

practices.label: Creative communities
practices.text: Artistic research with and for communities, places and collectives.

practices.label: Voice and authorship
practices.text: Who speaks through a work: authorship, authority and authenticity.

outputs.label: Rebordering the Archipelago
outputs.text: Panels, artist presentations and essays from APARN2020, edited by convenors Danny Butt and Kurniawan Adi Saputro, in English and Bahasa Indonesia. Published by Perimeter Editions and launched at SAR’s 2025 conference in Porto.

outputs.label: Climate/Coloniality
outputs.text: A thematic residency with PRAKSIS Oslo. Ten residents, chosen from over 130 applications, spent five weeks in fieldwork and dialogue in August and September 2025. A publication is forthcoming.

outputs.label: Chapalang
outputs.text: A touring exhibition curated by Gunalan Nadarajan and Roopesh Sitharan, on vernacular, “making do” approaches to technology in Southeast Asia. Artspace @ Helutrans, Singapore, 22 January to 1 February 2026.

outputs.label: APARN in JAR
outputs.text: APARN’s channel in the Journal for Artistic Research: 24 contributions from APARN events and 4 highlighted JAR publications from the region.

outputs.label: APARN2025 Proceedings
outputs.text: Published proceedings of the Bangkok conference.
